code:
name: Reusable Test
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      node-version:
        required: false
        type: string
        default: '{{node_version}}'
    secrets:
      NPM_TOKEN:
        required: false

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: { node-version: ${{ inputs.node-version }} }
      - run: npm ci && npm test
